articles.title: NASA Spots the Lunar Grave of a SpaceX Rocket That Slammed Into the Moon
articles.summary: A SpaceX Falcon 9 upper stage hit the moon at 5,400 mph on Aug. 5. NASA's LRO has now imaged the 60-foot-wide crater near Einstein Crater.

articles.title: High School Sophomore Wins $10,000 for Tongue-Controlled Wheelchair Interface
articles.summary: Holly Tang's Tonguage uses a standard webcam to let users steer a wheelchair with tongue movements and click with eye blinks. She won the IEEE Presidents' Scholarship.

articles.title: DNA-Based Memory Device Uses 100x Less Power, Paving Way for Brain-Like Computers
articles.summary: Penn State researchers built a memristor from synthetic DNA and perovskite that operates on under 0.1 volt and stays stable for weeks. It could boost AI efficiency.
